# COSMOS-authored real-PDF qualification fixtures

These PDFs are original COSMOS engineering-identity fixtures.

They contain no NASA, Huzel, or other third-party copyrighted prose.

Text-layer fixtures are generated by `knowledge.pdf.writer.write_extractable_pdf`.

Scanned (image-only) fixtures are generated by `knowledge.pdf.image_pdf.write_scanned_pdf`.
Complex-equation, Greek-catalogue, and NASA-class structural fixtures are COSMOS originals
(`complex_equations.pdf`, `greek_symbols.pdf`, `nasa_class_fixture.pdf`). Catalog hashes live in
`OCR_CORPUS.json`.
